SELECT queue_id, client_site, sites_list, chunk_index, total_chunks, period, status, priority, task_id, error_message, created_at FROM task_queue

=INSERT INTO task_queue (queue_id, client_id, client_site, sites_list, chunk_index, total_chunks, period, status, priority, task_id, error_message)
SELECT
  '{{ $json.queue_id }}',
  c.id,
  '{{ $json.client_site }}',
  '{{ $json.sites_list }}',
  {{ $json.chunk_index }},
  {{ $json.total_chunks }},
  '{{ $json.period }}',
  '{{ $json.status }}',
  {{ $json.priority }},
  '{{ $json.task_id }}',
  '{{ $json.error_message }}'
FROM clients c WHERE c.client_site = '{{ $json.client_site }}'
ON CONFLICT (queue_id) DO NOTHING

parameters.query: SELECT queue_id, client_site, sites_list, chunk_index, total_chunks, period, status, priority, task_id, error_message, created_at FROM task_queue

=INSERT INTO error_logs (task_id, robot_type, period, sites, status, error_message, url)
VALUES (
  '{{ $json.task_id }}',
  '{{ $json.robot_type }}',
  '{{ $json.period }}',
  '{{ $json.sites }}',
  '{{ $json.status }}',
  '{{ $json.error_message }}',
  '{{ $json.url }}'
)
=UPDATE task_queue SET status = 'done', task_id = '{{ $json.task_id }}' WHERE queue_id = '{{ $json.queue_id }}'

=SELECT c.client_site, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE tq.status IN ('pending', 'processing')) AS remaining, COUNT(*) AS total, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE tq.status = 'done') AS done FROM task_queue tq JOIN clients c ON c.id = tq.client_id WHERE tq.client_id = (SELECT client_id FROM task_queue WHERE queue_id = '{{ $json.queue_id }}' LIMIT 1) GROUP BY c.client_site
